units.source_text: 丈夫在研究室里过夜的日子多了。

en.t: Her husband began spending more and more nights at the laboratory.

units.source_text: 有时候一踏进家门，

en.t: Sometimes, the moment he stepped through the door,

units.source_text: 也许是用显微镜观察细胞，视线过于疲劳的缘故吧，

en.t: perhaps because his eyes were exhausted from observing cells through a microscope,

units.source_text: 丈夫一见夫人的姿影就格外亢奋，

en.t: the sight of his wife would throw him into an extraordinary excitement,

units.source_text: 将公文包一扔，帽子也不脱，

en.t: and he would toss aside his briefcase without even taking off his hat,

units.source_text: 旋即把手搭在夫人的肩膀上，

en.t: then immediately place his hand on his wife's shoulder,

units.source_text: 活像跳交际舞一般从大门口翩翩起舞，

en.t: and begin dancing gracefully from the front entrance as if in a ballroom dance,

units.source_text: 只顾在屋子里旋转个不停。

en.t: spinning endlessly around the house.

units.source_text: 小狗紧跟在他们后面，边吠边追，

en.t: The little dog followed close behind them, barking as it chased after them,

units.source_text: 还一个劲地咬着丈夫的脚后跟。

en.t: and kept biting at the husband's heels.

units.source_text: 丈夫兴致盎然，越跳越兴奋。

en.t: The husband was in high spirits and grew more excited the longer he danced.

units.source_text: 夫人逐渐感到扫兴，被丈夫拖着迈步。

en.t: His wife gradually lost interest and was dragged along by him as she stepped.

units.source_text: 丈夫时不时一边望着小狗的脸，

en.t: From time to time, the husband would look at the little dog's face,

units.source_text: 一边佯装要揍夫人的模样。

en.t: while pretending that he was about to strike his wife.

units.source_text: 小狗勃然变色冲着丈夫狂吠。

en.t: The little dog instantly changed its expression and barked furiously at the husband.

units.source_text: 夫人请盲人按摩师做按摩的时候，

en.t: When the wife had a blind masseur give her a massage,

units.source_text: 小狗就扑到盲人的脸上。

en.t: the little dog would leap at the blind man's face.

units.source_text: 夜间，丈夫从研究室沿着住宅街走回家时，

en.t: At night, when the husband walked home from the laboratory through the residential streets,

units.source_text: 一处处的狗尾随丈夫，不断吠吼。

en.t: dogs from place after place trailed him, barking and howling without end.

units.source_text: 因为他的西服上带有狗尸骸的气味。

en.t: It was because his suit carried the smell of dogs' carcasses.

units.source_text: 夫人的硬毛小猎犬之所以异乎寻常地缠着丈夫，

en.t: The reason his wife's wire-haired little hunting dog clung to him so unusually,

units.source_text: 并用鼻子磨蹭他的膝盖，

en.t: and rubbed its nose against his knees,

units.source_text: 那是因为当天丈夫屠宰了一条发情期的母狗。

en.t: was that he had slaughtered a female dog in heat that very day.

units.source_text: 夫人去伊香保温泉旅行的十天期间，

en.t: During the ten days when his wife traveled to the Ikaho hot springs,

units.source_text: 小狗几乎不进食，骤然消瘦了。

en.t: the little dog hardly ate and suddenly grew thin.

units.source_text: 夫人带着女佣出门，

en.t: When the wife went out with the maid,

units.source_text: 把狗单独留在家里的时候，

en.t: leaving the dog alone at home,

units.source_text: 狗就会满屋子搜寻主人，

en.t: the dog would search the entire house for its mistress,

units.source_text: 把全家一处处纸隔扇都挠穿，

en.t: scratch holes through the paper sliding doors all over the house,

units.source_text: 把棉被的棉絮咬得七零八碎，

en.t: bite the cotton batting of the quilts to shreds,

units.source_text: 还在卧床的枕头上拉屎。

en.t: and even defecate on the pillow in the bedding.

units.source_text: 狗的粪便似乎表明它极度愤怒和悲伤。

en.t: The dog's feces seemed to express its extreme anger and grief.

units.source_text: 因为那是狗和夫人总是并头共枕的枕头。

en.t: For it was the pillow on which the dog and the wife always slept side by side.

units.source_text: 夫人教唆枕边的狗。

en.t: The wife incited the dog at her pillow.

units.source_text: 而她看到丈夫遭到狗袭击的时候，

en.t: And when she saw her husband being attacked by the dog,

units.source_text: 似乎反而感到高兴。

en.t: she seemed, on the contrary, to feel pleased.

units.source_text: 丈夫与狗的争斗，能使夫人感到体内青春的热血潮涌。

en.t: The struggle between her husband and the dog made the wife feel the hot blood of youth surging inside her body.
